title: KeonEnvelope
description: Canonical MCP Gateway response envelope for Keon tool calls (S8, contract-first for S8-S13). Wire format uses snake_case gateway fields (correlation_id, policy_hash) mirroring MCPGW-008; isError mirrors the MCP CallToolResult boolean from the marketops-mcp tool surface. The gateway names the producing tool in `tool` (today the transport exposes docs_as_marketing_review; Keon tools arrive as keon.*). correlation_id threads into MarketOps receipts as correlationId (PublishPacket.correlationId). Policy denial is status=denied with denial fields (mirrors GateResult); transport failure is isError=true; effect-bearing paths fail closed on either.

correlation_id.description: Gateway wire id for this call. Threaded into MarketOps receipts as correlationId; every downstream receipt cites it.

tool.description: Keon gateway tool that produced this envelope, e.g. keon.runtime.decide.v1, keon.browseahead.scan.v1.

ok.description: True iff status is ok. Gateway-level success; distinct from transport isError.

status.description: Outcome class: ok (authorized), denied (policy denial, denial fields required), error (transport/effect failure, fail-closed for effect-bearing paths).

Gateway decision. Coarse mirror of BioStack PolicyDecision: Allowed/AllowedWithChecksumDisclaimer map to authorize, Blocked to deny, RewriteRequired/EscalateToProviderReview to require-review (see joint-review mapping).

policy_hash.description: Mirrors BioStack PolicyHash(Value, Version). Unanchored rows carry the unmistakable marker value 'unanchored-local' version '0.0.0' (RuntimeReceiptFactory); never a real policy version.

result.description: Tool-specific result payload on authorize/require-review. Absent on denials and errors.

denialCode.description: Machine-readable denial code. Required when decision.status is deny (mirrors GateResult.denialCode).

denialMessage.description: Human-readable denial summary. Required when decision.status is deny (mirrors GateResult.denialMessage).

failureStage.description: Pipeline stage that failed (mirrors the GateResult.failureStage enum).

receipts.description: Decision/scan receipt URIs evidencing this call: keon://receipt/{id} when Keon-anchored, otherwise a distinct local unanchored scheme (never keon://). Mirrors DecisionReceipt.ReceiptUri.

isError.description: Mirrors the MCP CallToolResult isError boolean from the marketops-mcp tool surface (unknown_tool, invalid_input, llm_failure, ...). Transport-level failure; distinct from policy denial (status denied, ok false, isError false).
